entries: When {DISASTER:strikes} cuts off {place}, {first}, a {trait} {job}, must {DO_THING} {THING} {DEADLINE}, or no one gets home.
{first}, a {trait} {job} of {place}, finds {THING:!living,!bulky} {HIDING} and seeks its owner.
After {DISASTER:strikes} on {place}, the {rival} blames {SOMEONE:human,!plural}, and {first}, a {trait} {job}, reads the logs differently.
A {trait} {job} named {first} must {DO_PERSON:!inner} {SOMEONE:human,!plural} {DEADLINE}, though everything about {landmark:built} says it is a trap.
{first}, a {trait} {job}, receives {MESSAGE:physical} from {SOMEONE:human,!plural} and must reach {landmark:built} {DEADLINE}.
On {place}, {first}, a {trait} {job}, is asked to {DO_THING} {THING}, and learns the {rival} has done it before.
To clear {SOMEONE:human,!plural} of {DISASTER:manmade}, {first}, a {trait} {job}, must reach {landmark:built} {DEADLINE}.
Every night at {landmark:built} a signal repeats, and {first}, a {trait} {job}, must trace the sender {DEADLINE}.
A {trait} {job} named {first} inherits {THING} and a debt on {place} that the {rival} wants collected.
{first}, a {trait} {job}, is the last to see {SOMEONE:human,!plural}, and the first suspect in {DISASTER:manmade}.
When {THING:portable} turns up {HIDING}, {first}, a {trait} {job} of {place}, uncovers {DISASTER:manmade} no one will name.
At {landmark:built}, {first}, a {trait} {job}, discovers that {SOMEONE:human,!plural} has been dead for years.
